text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Eeeh~~! What is this~~~~~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Startled by a familiar voice, I hurried 
over thinking it was trouble again, but...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, amazing! Both of the ones you 
took are wonderful! Every single photo 
turned out great!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, it's embarrassing being praised 
like that~! But hey, I'm just glad you 
like it!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! If the photo turned out cute, it's 
also because Sweep herself is just so 
cute, you know?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh, familiar! Right now, those two are 
taking photos of me.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Grandma said she wanted to see Sweepy in 
her racewear, so I'm going to send her a 
picture♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And look, look! Check this out! Don't you 
think it turned out super well?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She showed me her camera roll. Photo after 
photo of her in her racing silk lined the 
screen...
choice_data_list: Every single one is a great photo!
Every single one is a great photo!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Right? The texture of the outfit and all 
the tiny details came out so crisp and 
clear—it really brings out my witchy charm 
to the fullest!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You both have great taste! It looks like 
it was captured with time-stopping magic♪

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Oh, it's not that big a deal♪ 
Hehe... Not at all!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I know! Since we're at it, let's take an 
even more amazing photo!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Something more magical and sparkly! 
Something amazing, like a movie poster!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh? So what does that mean... What kind 
of feeling is it... Hmm?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I mean, can an amateur even film something 
like that? All I got is my smartphone 
camera, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"What?! After *I* recognized your skills, 
you're saying you can't do it?!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You guys can totally take an even better 
shot than this! Come on, do it! Pleeease 
do it~!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, alright, alright, I get it! If you're 
gonna go that far, I guess I've got no 
choice!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... If it's come to this, I'll 
prove that I'm number one in photos too!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay! That's what I'm talking about! Now, 
how should I take the next shot...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Familiar, think too! Don't you have any 
good ideas?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having the topic thrown to me so suddenly, 
I mull it over... How about we try 
changing the location?
choice_data_list: An artistic shot in a desolate place
A Photoshoot at a Trendy Spot!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, in that case, I know a great spot! 
It's a bit far, but follow me!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"This is where my dad took me on his 
motorcycle for a tour the other day! 
Pretty cool, isn't it?!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Isn't this awesome! It feels like... a 
wasteland where a cool witch would live!
choice_data_list: Let's take a photo right away!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, there's a nice breeze blowin'! 
Fluttering lookin' all cool~! Strike a 
pose!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Take the shot more from the side! 
Before the wind dies down! Hurryyyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
From this angle, right? Here I go... Yeah, 
lookin' pretty cool, aren't I?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes, perfect! I'm really feeling it 
now! Alright, next pose!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ah, watch the reflector board~~~! The 
angle of the light is all wrong!! Do it 
right—!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heh...! Instead of a genius magical girl, 
being a 'lone genius witch' doesn't sound 
half bad either.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, look at the time already. That took 
quite a while, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Still, I got an amazing photo! Fufufu, 
Grandma is sure to love it!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I know the perfect place. 
It's a trendy, photogenic spot recently—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Awesome~!! So witchy~! Scarlet, you really 
get it♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I had a feeling you'd like something 
like this. Shall we order some photogenic 
sweets, then?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: *sniff*, *sniff*! Smells so nice...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah! What a great smile! Photo op...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"...Ouch! Hot, hot, hot! Jeez, isn't this 
a bit too hot?!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, don't move, don't move! Keep your 
face pointed this way!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You can take photos even if I'm moving, 
right? In fact, it makes for more dynamic 
shots, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
More importantly... that familiar's cake 
looks pretty tasty! Hey, can I have a 
bite?
choice_data_list: I'll give it to you, so hold still~!
I'll give it to you, so hold still, okay~!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, look at the time already. That took 
quite a while, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Still, I got an amazing photo! Fufufu, 
Grandma is sure to love it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
All three of you did just as I expected. 
You didn't do half bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! I'll give you some praise! I 
wouldn't mind asking you guys again♪ It's 
a special exception, though!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heh...! Good grief, that was quite an 
ordeal~.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, really. Still... seeing them that 
happy, well, how could I not?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I certainly understand that feeling..." 
That was what I thought as dusk fell.
